SWORDS GYM

FLYEfit Swords is in Airside Retail Park, just five minutes from Dublin Airport and the Pavilion Shopping Centre. This is one of the largest FLYEfit gyms that features a range of cutting-edge equipment, a large range of cardio machines, spin studio, Astro area and Olympic lifting.

From June 6th, Swords will be RETURNING TO 24 HOURS Monday – Friday! Weekends & Bank Holidays excluded.
Members can avail of 2-hours free parking in basement carpark. PIN number required to exit and this is available in the Gym.
Join Today TAKE A TOUR

Why Choose Our Swords Gym?

  • One of the largest FLYEfit gyms
  • 24-hour access from Monday to Friday
  • Olympic lifting area and Eleiko equipment
  • High-performance, Astro and functional training areas
  • Heated chamber and dedicated spin studio
  • Two hours’ free parking at Airside Retail Park
  • FLYEhub timetable

Opening Hours

Opening hours listed below

Monday – Friday 24 hours.
(Opens 5.30am Monday, closes Saturday at 7.30pm).
* Sundays & Bank Holidays 7.30am – 7.30pm.

Open 7 days a week
(except Christmas day)

23:04 18 Dec 16
I tried going for one visit as was staying just overnight to catch a flight the next day.These guys offer 24 hour access but it comes with a couple of cons. This is how it went for me:I went there with a towel and wallet to pay the fee for one visit. The place was pretty much unmanned up till where I managed that is. They offer a computer station where you can make a subscription and supposedly access the facility in a giffy.The online system expects you to be a local. No place to enter a foreign country / address. Why would they? What foreigner would go there? Well, the one who uses the airport right beside it I guess.Luckily it wasn’t too strict as I just put in the name of the hotel I was staying at.I then proceeded to fill in your usual details, including the last twelve digits of any credit card. This is only used to swipe it to open the turnstiles. Cool I thought.I also provided an email address at one point.It was then time for payment. No cash option here, only credit card. Fair enough, it is an unmanned station. 3d secure is great. That applies only if you are carrying your smartphone with you, which I am not. I am only a foreigner with a towel and a wallet.I am determined to use the gym. I enthusiastically return to the hotel, grab my phone and head back to Flyefit.By now the online system has forgot all the details of this foreigner. Fair enough. After filling some details, I get to input my email again. Which I do. The online system is intelligent and informs me that this email cannot be used again. Instead it says to click on a link in an email that has been sent to me, so I may resume my registration. Perfect, I think. Oh wait, I don’t have internet here. I’m a foreigner with no data contract. No problem! I will use Flyefit’s wi-fi. Er…. Nope! No problem I’ll use some other open wi-fi signal. Nope! I’m not getting lucky!As you do, you have multiple email accounts. I’ll just use a different one. I’m very excited at this point. I’ll soon be on that treadmill.I re-enter my last twelve credit card digits to open the turnstiles. Oh! Seems like I can’t. Of course this online system is pretty intelligent and remembers these digits are associated with the previous email I tried to use!I have run out of credit card numbers, since I wasn’t alone in this adventure. My wife was also hopeful to use the gym, and we used different credit card numbers to register her own account.Something else I ran out of at that point was patience. So I went to TGI’s next door and ate Cajun chicken. And mozzarella dippers. And chicken wings.

08:59 25 Mar 16
This is a great gym, it’s open 24/7 which makes it very convenient for me. The facilities are great and the equipment range is fairly good. It’s kept nice and clean and the staff are friendly and very helpful.Unlike many other leisure facilities, it doesn’t have a swimming pool, jacuzzi, sauna or steam room. It’s strictly a gym.It offers loads of fitness classes, free to members. The membership itself it fairly cheap compared to other gyms out there, especially giving the wide range of equipment they have on offer compared to other gyms.From my experience, it’s usually busiest from around 5pm up until about 9pm. All other times are more convenient if you’re workout consists of using various equipment through out a short space of time. Peak times could have you waiting around.The reason I gave 4 stars instead of 5 is because of the free weight section. One reason being the dumbells do be all over the place and it can be hard and time consuming to find the correct weight or even two of the same. Another reason is the dumbell weight range, the weight seems to go from 1KG to 12KG straight forward enough, but once it goes past 12KG it starts jumping numbers causing you to ether stay on a weight longer or progress sometimes 2.5KG.’s more. Depending on the exercise that can be a big and unsafe jump.But overall it’s a great gym and I’d highly recommend it!!

Ass & Abs

Does this class really need a description? We will strengthen and tone those all important areas! We will use a variety of equipment including barbells, dumbbells and kettlebells.

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Box

BOX is a form exercise that has boxing style concepts. It will involve shadow boxing, punching, ducking, combos. There will also be conditioning circuits added in to help speed, endurance and power. Teaming up with a buddy and doing pad work will be also in the class. Great class for dropping body fat, getting fit and getting that anger on the pads!

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
BR Groove

BR Groove is Brazilian Beats, Worldwide Vibes. Feel the rhythm, bring the energy, and move with purpose in BR Groove—a fitness-focused workout inspired by the vibrant beats of Brazilian culture. This high-energy class blends music, movement, and fun to deliver a full-body cardio experience that’s all about rhythm and flow. Open to all fitness levels, BR Groove is more than just a workout—it’s a celebration. Expect uplifting tracks, global vibes, and feel-good energy from start to finish. No dance experience needed—just bring your groove!

Book Now
Coach by Color

Coach by Color is a spin class designed to show you how hard you’re working and to help you get what you want out of the class. The colors are personal to you, based on your own fitness level, so everyone can train at the right intensity for their body. It helps you pace yourself, stay motivated, and get the most out of the workout without guessing how hard you’re working.

Book Now
DanceHIIT

DanceHIIT is a high intensity interval training workout that combines high-energy cardio dance routines with targeted strength training exercises for a total body workout. This will be a fun, high energy class bringing your fitness to the next level!

BOOK NOW WATCH ON FLYE+ 
FLYE Conditioning

FLYE Conditioning is a class designed for all levels. The class is designed to increase your fitness capacity as well as your strength by combining cardio exercises with resistance training in short bursts. Guaranteed to increase your cardiovascular ability as well as get a pump on!

Book Now
FLYEfit Strength

FLYEfit Strength is the perfect class for those who want to gain more functional strength through the use of dumbbells kettlebells and other equipment. The FLYEfit coaches will bring you through a balanced strength training session correcting form and positions throughout! Our plan is to give you all you need to turn yourself into the strongest version of you!

Book Now
Heated Polar

Heated Polar is a high intensity class that is set in a heated chamber with a climate of 30°. You are given a Polar Heart rate monitor at the start of the class which is displayed on the screen in front of you to help you work harder and compete with friends. The class uses a combination of our Concept Bike, Row & Ski Ergs and Assault fitness bikes which will definitely get you sweating! A great class for increasing endurance and fitness!

Book Now
Hot Pilates

Heated Pilates is a low-impact, high-burn class designed to sculpt, strengthen and restore.Set in a heated studio of 30degrees, the warmth allows muscles to work deeper while improving mobility and circulation. Expect controlled Pilates movements, strong core work and a serious sweat, all without high impact.

Book Now
Hot Yoga

In a FLYEfit Yoga class you will be guided through a sequence of physical postures promoting flexibility, mobility, stability, and strength. Book in today with our fully qualified instructors.

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Hyrox

HYROX combines both running & functional workout stations, using our Concept Equipment, Sleds and other equipment we will accommodate both professional athletes, and everyday fitness enthusiasts looking to take their training to the next level, HYROX is the sport for everybody.

Book Now
MET CON

FLYEfit MetCon is a high-energy class designed to boost your fitness fast through Metabolic Conditioning – a training style that combines strength and cardio to burn calories, build endurance, and increase overall performance. Suitable for all fitness levels.

Book Now
Mobility Flow

Mobility Flow is a class that everybody needs in their life! This class is designed to reduce tension, loosen stiff muscles and improve range of motion making you feel fantastic! Improving mobility is so important in daily life.

Book Now
Pilates

Pilates conditions your entire body – even your feet!  It is a full body and mind workout that focuses on muscle balance, posture alignment, flexibility and core strength. No muscle group is overlooked or overused which will allow you to enjoy daily activities and sports with better performance and less chance of injury.

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Polar Conditioning

FLYE Conditioning is a class designed for all levels. The class is designed to increase your fitness capacity as well as your strength by combining cardio exercises with resistance training in short bursts. Guaranteed to increase your cardiovascular ability as well as get a pump on! You can track your workout through the Polar wrist strap keeping an eye on your calories burned and heart rate.

Book Now
Polar Spin

Using our state of the art Spin bikes, you can track calories and training data using Polar optical heart rate monitors in a fun, challenging environment!

Book Now
Pump

Pump is one of the best ways to get in shape and tone up as it challenges all of your major muscle groups while you squat, press, lift and curl.  A fun class with great benefits and also a great introduction to weight training.

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Spin

FLYEfit Spin is not just an indoor cycling class but an indoor cycling experience. Let the energy and music move you. This class will take you on a journey through tough climbs and fast sprints. The ultimate calorie burning class that will have you racing to the finish line!

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Step

A classic is back – Step. This choreographed session will let you ‘step up a sweat’.  You’ll burn calories and shape your body with lots of jam-packed fun and enjoyable dance moves. Come along to step up and down to some of your favourite tunes.

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Sweat

Are you chasing that feeling you only get after a good sweat session? Sweat is the class for you. In this class we use heart rate training as our main go to to give you that feel good factor. Using circuits, emoms, amraps and other conditioning methods. Our flyefit coaches will guide you through a balanced fitness session to make you the fittest you’ve ever been!

Book Now
Themed Spin

Themed Spin at FLYEfit is your midweek energy boost, every Wednesday at 6pm! Each month brings a new theme – from 70s disco and 80s anthems to 90s throwbacks, 00s hits, pop icons, and rock legends – all paired with a high-energy spin workout that will leave you buzzing. Available in all gyms with spin studios. Come along for the ride of your life!

Book Now
TRX

TRX training is a type of workout that uses suspension straps to build strength, balance, and flexibility using your own body weight. The class is designed for all levels.

Book Now
TRYKA

You may have heard of TRYKA and wondered what it actually is.TRYKA is a form of hybrid training, combining cardio and strength in one high-energy session. This class takes you through the official movements used in TRYKA racing, including sled pushes, lunges, ram thrusters, rowing and functional strength work. A perfect alternative to HYROX and suitable for all fitness levels, whether you’re trying it for the first time or training to compete.

Book Now
Yin Yoga

Yin Yoga is a slow, gentle style of yoga that focuses on stretching deeply and relaxing your body and mind. You hold each pose for a few minutes. It targets deep tissues like ligaments, joints, and fascia — not just your muscles. You use relaxed breathing and let your body sink into the stretch. It’s quiet, calm, and helps release tension.

Book Now
Yoga

In a FLYEfit Yoga class you will be guided through a sequence of physical postures promoting flexibility, mobility, stability, and strength. Book in today with our fully qualified instructors.

Book Now Watch on FLYE+ 
Yogalates

Yogalates is a fusion of Yoga and Pilates designed to improve core strength, flexibility, posture, and mindfulness. This low-impact class combines the breathwork and flow of Yoga with the strength and toning elements of Pilates, helping to build stability, reduce stress, and support overall wellbeing. Suitable for all fitness levels.

Book Now
ZUMBA

Zumba is a fun, high-energy workout that combines easy-to-follow dance moves with upbeat music. It’s designed to get your heart rate up, burn calories, and make exercise feel more like a party than a workout. No dance experience needed, just move, sweat, and have fun!

Book Now

You also have the option to opt-out of these cookies. But opting out of some of these cookies may have an effect on your browsing experience.
